corpus at this commit, unchanged. License: MIT (see LICENSE).
The test harness explicitly skips upstream cases marked options.skip=typescript;
these represent upstream unsupported behavior, not adapter conformance passes.
Finite adapter budgets can reject larger inputs than upstream accepts.

workflow-parser/testdata/reader corpus (195 YAML files). The copied

workflow-parser/testdata/skipped-tests.txt at this commit (93 entries).
